run_role: final acceptance run after a measured benchmark-client connection fix
connection_policy: 32 persistent loopback sessions; open arrivals remain independent of response completion
acceptance: Met: the 200-rps stage completed 6,000 requests with zero failures, 14 ms HTTP p99, 14.30 ms scheduled-arrival p99, and 78.85 ms maximum scheduler lag.
limitations: This validates an isolated loopback synthetic model, PostgreSQL lookup, and HTTP path. It does not establish real-data model quality or cloud production latency.
The earlier failed curves and rejected two-worker trial remain retained as investigation evidence; this final run uses the corrected bounded session count.
